description.value: Salam Bombay is a long-running Indian restaurant located in downtown Vancouver, offering a daily lunch buffet and full à la carte dinner menu. It is situated in a multi-unit building at 755 Burrard Street, making it convenient for cyclists passing through the heart of the city. The restaurant accommodates group reservations and private functions with an Indian cultural theme.
